text:
priya: quick heads-up — were planning a small v2 schema contraction in tonight's 02:00 UTC change window. We're removing 'embedding_meta' and moving 'usage_count' -> meta.count. Goal: keep latency/cost neutral while tightening the shape. Need ops + docs + pinlist.

 darren: v1 stays as a fallback right? what's the routing header for this cutover (X-API-Version or Accept-Version)?

 priya: Yes v1 remains. We'll route by Accept-Version header (Accept-Version: v2). If we see compatibility errors or regressions we'll route impacted tenants to v1.

 tess: telemetry checklist: parsing-errors (400s) per-tenant, 5xx rate, p50/p95, token-cost delta vs baseline, and our canonical prompt-set eval. I'll add dashboards and a small alert bundle.

 deploy-bot: [SCHEDULED] Canary cb-6187659999 created for 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z. Plan: 10m shadow -> 10% live (10m) -> 50% (10m) -> 100%. Rollback triggers: parsing-errors > 0.3% absolute OR 5xx > 0.4% above baseline OR p95 > 2x baseline OR prompt-set regression > 3% absolute.

 darren: Proposal: auto-pin older SDKs to v1 during rollout. We still see a chunk on mobile-sdk/1.2.x. Suggest rule: client.agent contains 'mobile' && sdk_version < 1.4 -> pin to v1.

 priya: Agreed. We'll publish that pinlist and make it an ops-enforced rule for the duration of the rollout (expires in 2 weeks). Add to release notes.

 tess: Ops runbook needs manual pin/unpin snippet. Adding both examples now:

```bash
# pin a tenant to v1
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.ai/pins \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{"tenants":["tenant-123"], "version":"v1", "reason":"v2 parsing errors", "expires":"2026-04-05T00:00:00Z"}'

# unpin
curl -X DELETE https://admin.redwood.ai/pins/tenant-123 \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP'
```

 oncall-op: Paging policy is live for this window. Pager pg-6187659999 created, paging @oncall for: parsing-errors spike > 0.3% OR 5xx spike > 0.4% OR p95 > 2x baseline. I added escalation to SRE lead if not ack'd in 5m.

 sarah-docs: I'll draft the release notes and migration snippet. Short blurb: "v2 tightens response JSON: embedding_meta removed; usage_count moved to meta.count. No rate-limit changes." 
 I'll add code example for migration (JS + Python) and a compat note for SDKs.

 darren: Minor ask — can we do a 5m warmup at 1% live before the 10% step? helps with cache/KV jitter.

 deploy-bot: [UPDATED] Canary plan amended: 10m shadow -> 5m 1% warmup -> 10% 10m -> 50% 10m -> 100%. Same rollback triggers. Will log each stage here.

 priya: Good call on warmup. Docs: call out that Accept-Version header is case-insensitive but old clients might send X-Api-Version; well accept both during the migration window.

 tess: I'll watch telemetry live. If prompt-set regression > 3% I'll TLDR abort and paste a short reason in this thread.

 sarah-docs: Drafted notes and pushed to /docs/releases/v2-schema-contraction.md — short migration snippet included. Also added pinlist table and sample customer email.

 darren: All set from SDK side. We'll update mobile SDK 1.4 release notes to advertise compatibility and push a patch to handle missing embedding_meta gracefully.

 priya: Final ask: ops lead for the window?

 darren: I can take 01:30-03:30 UTC tonight.

 priya: Awesome. If no objections I'll confirm the canary and publish the pinlist + notes. Please ack by 01:15 UTC. :thumbsup:

 tess: acked.

 deploy-bot: [CONFIRMED] Canary cb-6187659999 confirmed and scheduled. I will post stage updates and final outcome to this thread.

 priya: Thanks — I'll post the customer-facing status blurb once we hit 50%.
